CommunityApplications.Profile: Talaria is a web app and Telegram bot for Hermes Agent, with a sandbox for the agent's commands and your own computers paired in. This repository ships the Unraid template for the all-in-one Talaria container. Setup guide: https://usa-reddragon.github.io/talaria/deploy/unraid.html. Support: https://github.com/USA-RedDragon/talaria/issues
